requirements.title: Sidebar Tab Navigation
requirements.description: Provide tabbed navigation between the app's sections via a collapsible left sidebar (src/surfaces/graph/components/sidebar/), with a tab bar (activity, backlog, captures, initiatives, operatingModes, executions, sessions) and a header showing the 'Swarm Manager' app title. Supersedes the original desktop header tab bar (Backlog/Scenarios/Execution/Settings), which was replaced by the sidebar in the UI reorganization.

validation.ref: ui/src/surfaces/graph/components/sidebar/SidebarTabs.test.tsx::shows actionable entity badges for backlog, captures, executions, and sessions
validation.notes: Sidebar tab bar renders the navigable section tabs (backlog/captures/executions/sessions)
Sidebar header renders the 'Swarm Manager' app title and home navigation

requirements.title: Mobile Bottom Navigation
requirements.description: RETIRED: the separate mobile bottom navigation bar described here was never shipped. The reorganized UI uses a single collapsible sidebar (REQ-P0-009-DESKTOP) on every breakpoint rather than a distinct mobile bottom-nav. OT-P0-008's mobile-bottom-nav clause is unsatisfied by design; re-scoping it to the responsive sidebar is a prd-control-tower decision, not a registry edit.

validation.ref: Mobile bottom navigation was not implemented; the collapsible sidebar (REQ-P0-009-DESKTOP) serves all breakpoints. See requirements/08-tabbed-navigation-ui/module.json description.
validation.notes: Documented removal: no distinct mobile bottom-nav exists in the reorganized UI.
